axes.line: no stale repetition; an echo placed on purpose is not repetition
observable behaviour over asserted inner states

directives.player-action-uptake: enact the declared action from the world's view
directives.rewrite-abstract-explanation-to-action: inner states become action, voice, posture, gaze, evidence
directives.skill-interpretation-after-visible-evide: skill judgement after the visible evidence
directives.final-prose-guard-before-output: reread: complete natural sentences; context is facts, not phrasing
directives.repetition-policy: settled facts briefly, but as complete sentences; never fragments; enact this action
directives.action-uptake-review: check the draft enacts the action, not the player's phrasing
directives.rewrite-ai-summary-voice: information via scene detail or NPC speech, not report voice
directives.rewrite-camera-direction-staging: one natural sentence names the person and the focus
directives.rewrite-passive-translation-ese: active voice, clear subject, concrete action
directives.rewrite-abstract-psychological-explanati: visible behaviour first; explain after evidence or a skill result

floor: uptake: enact the player's declared action or words from the world's view; one word is still a declaration
answer: show settled outcomes; answer the chosen exchange or clarification; quiet play needs no new event; offers are advice
voice: anyone present the exchange touches speaks a line in their own voice
handoff: enough public context; return at a new unselected decision or completed goal; never repeat a chosen step or force a question; never a menu
